reviews.decision_reason: The selection boundary preserves the target corpus rows needed by downstream review. Its filter keeps all rows with demand_score >= 3 and explicitly retains fallback ids n06-r07 and n06-r08, so the target input's eight rows remain visible rather than being dropped by generic keyword matching or unrelated expansion.

The normalization boundary retains only the allowed record identifiers and applies the explicit bounded eight-row window. For this package, that keeps all supplied demand rows and does not introduce unsupported or contradictory candidates. The package does not independently prove market demand beyond the supplied corpus fields, so that limitation remains visible rather than upgraded into independent corroboration.

The provenance assembly boundary deterministically ranks the normalized records by descending demand_score with record_id as a stable tie-breaker, producing evidence_sources for all eight rows. That supports the downstream deterministic recommendation because unsupported n06-r01 has provenance rank 1 and unsupported n06-r07 has rank 7. The supplied runtime handoff records show exact producer and consumer hashes for both needs and evidence_sources.
